means.example-sentence: In order to reduce pollution, everyone should use public transportation as much as possible.
means.sentence-jp: 汚染を減らすためには、全員ができる限り公共交通機関を使うべきだ。

cloze.maskedText: ____ reduce pollution, everyone should use public transportation as much as possible.
cloze.answerBase: in order to do / so as to do

notes: 肯定文では to do のみでもよいが、「…しないために」の意味では in order や so as を省略せずに in order [so as] not to do の形で用いる。
